objectives.description: Class B strict mode, PASSED/FAILED counters, isolated mktemp -d git repo per case

approaches_tried.approach: Ran the new suite against the Phase 3/4 script before declaring it done
approaches_tried.reason: (1) the book_requires-churn grep's '^\+[^+].*book_requires' pattern never matched a genuinely added line because [^+] consumed the leading content character the literal then needed; fixed to '^\+[^+]*book_requires'. (2) a jq 'select([$dims[]] | index(.))' expression had '.' already rebound to the piped array by an enclosing pipe, so index() always found the array inside itself; fixed by binding the dimension value to a named variable ($d) before select(). Both fixed inline and re-verified green (47/47).
